en.headline: Hong Kong China face Tonga in double-header at Kai Tak today
en.dek: Women’s international at 2 p.m. and men’s Nations Cup fixture at 5 p.m. at Kai Tak Youth Sports Ground, with tickets from HK$100.
body: Hong Kong China Rugby hosts Tonga in a double-header at Kai Tak Youth Sports Ground today. The women’s representative side faces Tonga at 2 p.m., followed by an advance screening of the documentary The Qualification, before the men’s XV takes the field at 5 p.m. in the final round of the World Rugby Nations Cup 2026.

Hong Kong China Rugby said the men’s side, captained by Josh Hrstich, aims to finish its Nations Cup campaign strongly after recent results. Tonga, ranked higher and featuring former All Black Ngani Laumape on debut, arrives after mixed results in the competition. The sides last met in a 2023 Rugby World Cup play-off, which Tonga won 44-22.

Gates open at 1 p.m. Adult tickets are priced at HK$180, students at HK$140 and children at HK$100, according to the organisers and the venue. The women’s match forms part of their international programme following earlier World Rugby WXV commitments.
Hong Kong China Rugby has described the day as featuring both test matches and family activities in the FunZone area alongside the pitch.

zh.headline: 港中國欖球隊今於啟德迎戰湯加 男女雙賽
zh.dek: 女子國際賽下午二時開波，男子Nations Cup決賽圈下午五時，啟德青年運動場，門票由100元起。
body: 香港中國欖球協會今日於啟德青年運動場舉行雙賽，迎戰湯加。女子代表隊下午二時對湯加，其後播放紀錄片《The Qualification》預映，男子隊則於下午五時在世界欖球Nations Cup 2026最後一輪出戰。
港中國欖球表示，男子隊由Josh Hrstich擔任隊長，希望在Nations Cup賽事以好成績作結。湯加排名較高，並有前紐西蘭全黑球員Ngani Laumape首次為湯加上陣。兩隊上次交手是2023年世界盃外圍賽，湯加以44比22勝出。
主辦單位及場地資料顯示，大門下午一時開放，成人門票180元、學生140元、兒童100元。女子賽事屬國際賽程一部分，承接較早前的世界欖球WXV系列。
港中國欖球形容，當日除兩場測試賽外，球場旁FunZone亦設有家庭活動。
